description: This file contains definitions of simple methods related to payment processing within the OFBiz framework, including setting and updating payment methods, creating payment group members, and handling PayPal payment methods.

methods.name: setPaymentMethodAddress
methods.description: Determines and sets the address details for a payment method based on its type (CREDIT_CARD or EFT_ACCOUNT).

methods.name: updatePaymentMethodAddress
methods.description: Updates all credit card and EFT account entries associated with a contactMechId to use a new contactMechId, handling expiration and creation of new records.

methods.name: expirePaymentGroupMember
methods.description: Expires a payment group member by setting its through date to the current timestamp.

methods.name: createPayPalPaymentMethod
methods.description: Creates a new PayPal payment method and its associated PayPalPaymentMethod entity, generating a new paymentMethodId if necessary.

methods.name: createPaymentGroupMember
methods.description: Creates a new payment group member for outgoing or incoming payments based on the payment group type, with checks for disbursements and receipts.
